batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved scan of the JU D Unit 2014-2015 paper in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-d-2014-2015-set1.pdf (6 pp.). ⚠ LISTING-VS-PRINTED SET-CODE DISCREPANCY: the Drive listing calls this file 'Set-1', but the printed header box on p.1 reads 'SET CODE: 1/2' — a merged pair code (Satt Academy's banks for this session are likewise merged pairs সেট ১/২ and ৩/৪). The printed code governs, so the paper id is ju-d-2014-2015-set1-2. The compilation prints each question with a ব্যাখ্যা and a boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' key (X = Bangla letter ক/খ/গ/ঘ, mapped to options a-d in printed order; a few English questions print Latin option labels (a)-(d) but still take Bangla-letter keys). Printed header: session ২০১৪-২০১৫, D-ইউনিট (জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ), 60 minutes, full marks 80. The compilation prints NO subject section headings; subjects were assigned per question by content and block position: Bangla Q1-4, General Mathematics Q5-6, IQ Q7, General Mathematics Q8, IQ Q9-10, General Mathematics Q11-12, English Q13-16, Biology Q17-56 (Botany Q17-36, Zoology Q37-56, assigned by content/block), Chemistry Q57-80. 80 questions: 78 with printed keys, 1 keyless (Q14 — key letter illegible under the aggregator watermark), 1 printed no-correct-option disposition (Q61, key box 'উত্তরঃ নাই'), 0 dual keys. Transcribed visually from 300 dpi renders read as column/band tiles with zoom crops for doubtful glyphs; render integrity verified by SHA-256 of the p.1 render (f987c132…) and by tile/full-page cross-checks. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: JU D Unit 2014-2015 question paper, printed SET CODE 1/2 (Drive listing 'Set-1') — compiler-solved scan (AdmissionWar / Google Drive PDF)
sourceDocuments.notes: CamScanner scan of a compiler-solved reprint (per-question ব্যাখ্যা with a boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' key after each question; keys use Bangla letters ক-ঘ). Aggregator footers 'For More Question Bank Visit www.admissionwar.com' and diagonal 'Admission War' watermarks are the aggregator's, not part of the question paper; a watermark swirl obscures the Q14 key letter. Handwritten/printed reader marks (e.g. a circle around Q16's number) are not keys. Two-column layout. Downloaded from the AdmissionWar Google Drive archive for the admission-research project. The Drive listing label 'Set-1' disagrees with the printed header box 'SET CODE: 1/2'; the printed code governs the paper id.

examRules.sourceNote: Printed header (PDF p.1): ১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক সম্মান ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৪-২০১৫; D-ইউনিট, জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়; boxed set label 'SET CODE: 1/2'; সময়ঃ ৬০ মিনিট, পূর্ণমানঃ ৮০. Printed instruction line under the header: (প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে। প্রশ্নপত্রে উত্তর চিহ্নিত করা যাবে না). Further printed instruction in the header box: পরীক্ষার শুরুতে OMR শিটের নির্ধারিত স্থানে নিচের দু'টি বাক্য লিখতে হবে — ১। প্রকৃতি বাঁচলেই আমরা বাঁচবো ২। Save nature, save life.
